regulation_name: All contracts must have an amount below EUR 3,000,000
A call already published must not be published again
Award must not occur before publication
Award must not occur before participation
Publication and participation must eventually lead to award
Award must be announced within 70 days of publication
Contract must not start before award
Contract must not end before publication
Contract must not end after publication without participation and award
A started contract must have a conclusion date
A contract that ended must have started first
A terminated contract must have been awarded
